caption: The drawing depicts an ornate interior scene featuring a symmetrical composition dominated by a central, green, tufted, circular bench-like structure with a multi-tiered, gold and blue candelabra on top. The floor consists of a checkered pattern made of red and off-white tiles, bordered by a large green carpet with a decorative floral design. On either side of the central structure are two large columns with marble-like surfaces and gold ornamental bands, extending up to the staircases that rise symmetrically to the left and right. Marble banisters with white balusters line the staircases. Prominently placed in the foreground are two red-roped stanchions attached to the marble columns with a “CLOSED” sign in gold and red letters across the central area. Two posters on light pink boards advertise performances: the left one advertises "Miss Nelly Farren as Ariel Galley," and the right one advertises "Miss Jennie O'Brien Fires A Rifle With Pigeons Pierce-O'Brien Galley," both featuring illustrated female figures. Scattered on the carpet and tiles are small red and white objects, a booklet with an open pink cover, and some pieces of paper. The background wall is yellow with purple decorative draping-like patterns and is adorned with elaborate white, gold, and blue wall sconces on each side. Three arched doors, labeled “AISLE 1,” “AISLE 2,” and “AISLE 3,” are in the back; the central door is double and open, showing a glimpse of a room with green chairs. Above the central area is a large circular blue ceiling painting featuring a pair of birds and clouds.
title: Theatre Lobby
